name: Aid
description: Your spell bolsters your allies with toughness and resolve. Choose up to three creatures within range. Each target gains temporary hit points for the duration.
effect: 5 temporary HP for you and up to two allies in a fight, or 5 temporary HP at the start of every fight for 8 hours.
notes: In combat: you and the two nearest allies gain 5 temporary HP.
Out of combat: for 8 hours you start every fight with 5 temporary HP.
